title: A Brunn--Minkowski inequality for the Hessian eigenvalue in convex domain
summary: We use the deformation methods to obtain the strictly log concavity of solution of a class Hessian equation in bounded convex domain in $\mathbb{R}^{n}$, as an application we get the Brunn--Minkowski inequality for the Hessian eigenvalue and characterize the equality case in bounded strictly convex domain in $\mathbb{R}^{n}$.
